system.description: This small hardened case contains a series of repair and maintenance tools carefully stored for ease of access. It contains a long list of tools and parts, including (but not limited to); an electric drill/driver with dozens of attachments and screws, portable welding torch, steel sheets, and powerful adhesives. A character can use this kit to repair 1d6 damage to a mechanical device (such as a drone). A proficient character repairs 2d6 damage.
